segments.t: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
“Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
“that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
segments.note: ἔσῃ μακροχρόνιος を「you may live long」とほぐす

segments.t: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
segments.note: 「to wrath」は παροργίζετε のほぐし。「You」は呼びかけの補い

segments.t: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,
segments.note: τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις を「those who according to the flesh are your masters」とほぐす

segments.t: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
segments.note: ὀφθαλμοδουλίαν を「service only when eyes are on you」とほぐす。ἐκ ψυχῆς は「from the heart」

segments.t: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,
knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.
segments.note: δοῦλος を「bound」と訳す。κομίσεται は「receive the same good again」

segments.t: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
segments.note: καὶ αὐτῶν καὶ ὑμῶν ὁ κύριός ἐστιν を「he who is both their Master and yours is ...」とほぐす

segments.t: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
segments.note: τὰ πνευματικὰ τῆς πονηρίας を「the spiritual forces of wickedness」とほぐす

segments.t: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
segments.note: ἀναλάβετε を WEB は「put on」と訳す

segments.t: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
segments.note: περιζωσάμενοι τὴν ὀσφὺν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ を「having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist」とほぐす

segments.t: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,
above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
segments.note: ἐν πᾶσιν を「above all」と訳す。βέλη は「fiery darts」

segments.t: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;
with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.
segments.note: εἰς αὐτὸ ἀγρυπνοῦντες を「being watchful to this end」とほぐす

segments.t: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,
segments.note: 文頭の「Pray」は英語の補い（18節の祈りの続き）

segments.t: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（Τυχικὸς ... πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν）

segments.t: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.
Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love.
segments.note: ἐν ἀφθαρσίᾳ を「with incorruptible love」とほぐす

segments.t: Amen.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Amen」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない
